Have a Great Day
1.1 Look, listen and say.
Hurrah!
Let's sing together.
Dear students, we are
going to sing a good
morning song.
2.1 Listen and sing.
Good morning!
Good morning!
How are you today?
I'm fine, I'm fine.
I wish you a good day.
English for Today
3.1 Language Focus: Using Expressions
You can say “Wish you a good day” before closing a conversation.
Here are some other ways to say—

subject: English
text:
¢ Have a great day.
¢ Wishing you a wonderful day.
¢ Have a good day.
¢ Have a nice day.
¢ Enjoy your day.
4.1 Sing the good morning song. When you say the last line, use
different expressions from the box on the right.
Good morning! - Have a great day.
Good morning! - Wishing you a wonderful day.
How are you today? - Have a nice day.
I'm fine, I'm fine. - Enjoy your day.
Have a great day.
